name: Swancon
blurb: Australia's longest-running science-fiction convention, run by the Western Australian Science Fiction Foundation each year in Perth.

picks: Fan Guest of Honour, data scientist

editions.evidence: swancon51.sf.org.au homepage: '(4th) 5th & 6th (7th) june 2027 the pagoda south perth — join us in perth, western australia, on the 5th and 6th of june for our conference, plus optional social activities on the 4th and 7th'

notes: The given URL swancon.com.au renders a completely empty page in Chromium, WebFetch and msedge alike (title only, 'Swancon51 (2027)'); the real, content-ID is a year-numbered WordPress subdomain. Swancon rolls to a new site each year: swancon50.sf.org.au (Natcon 2026, held 29 May–1 June 2026, already over as of this 2026-10-05 check) says 'our con is now over ... visit swancon51.sf.org.au to see what's happening in 2027', so this file's url/id point at swancon51.sf.org.au for the upcoming edition. Edition dates cover the full advertised span (4th–7th June); the core two-day conference is the 5th–6th, with the 4th and 7th as optional social add-on days. Guest photo candidate #2 on the guests page is a book-cover graphic, not a guest portrait, so it was not picked. Verify-05 recheck (2026-10-05): confirmed current -- a fresh extraction of swancon51.sf.org.au/guests/ still shows only these same two names, consistent with the site's year-numbered rollover (swancon51 = 2027).
